svg.aria-label: Two stories take turns. The search github readme banner is matched word by word against a README title: the old title lacks banner and gets a cross, the new one has all three words and gets a tick. Then the search web scraping mcp server is matched against a web page title: the old title has only web and gets a cross, the new one has all four words and gets a tick.
svg.text: Search engines match the words people type
A title that leaves out a searched word gets left out.
